name: Grok Automations
desc: Jobs you describe once, run by Grok on schedule or email.
desc_zh: 描述一次的任务，Grok 会按计划或在邮件到达时自动执行。
solves: Recurring research and inbox triage still eat your morning; Grok runs the job on its own and reports back.
solves_zh: 例行调研和收件箱清理仍在吃掉你的早晨；Grok 自己跑任务然后回来汇报。
best_for: You want the overnight reading summarized before you wake up, without setting up a script.
best_for_zh: 想在你醒之前就把夜间的阅读总结好，又不想写脚本时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — x.ai/news directory）。 Available on grok.com and in the Grok app on iOS and Android. Triggers are schedules or incoming email.
